subject: Launch prioritization + doc gap triage: readiness checklist and exceptions
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch prioritization + doc gap triage: readiness checklist and exceptions

Team —

We need to finalize the launch readiness checklist for the upcoming runtime rollout (target production week of May 24). I pulled together the first pass enablement deck and a proposed timeline (attached). High-level asks:

- Product: confirm feature freeze + API contract freeze date (we need this for docs and SDKs)
- Eng: mark which items are must-have for week 0 vs. week 1 (see "critical" column in the timeline)
- DX/Enablement: identify owners for each doc and customer-facing sample flows
- Security/Compliance: note any redlines that would force delay (we have one pending exception request from Nimbus)

Immediate open items I flagged in the deck:
1) SDK compatibility matrix (missing iOS/Android entries)
2) Support-runbook for canary failures
3) Nimbus Health exception: data-retention override for a small pilot (they emailed Elena; Elena on cc)

Please review the deck and the prod-exceptions.md attached. If you can annotate the Google doc linked below with owners by EOD Wednesday (May 4), I will consolidate and share a final checklist with execs.

Attachments: enablement-deck-v1.pdf, rollout-timeline-202705.xlsx, prod-exceptions.md

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch prioritization + doc gap triage: readiness checklist and exceptions

Thanks Sofia — quick questions after a skim: 

- Can you confirm the API contract freeze you mentioned — is that May 12 or May 17? Our plan was May 17 but the SDK timeline expects May 12.
- For the SDK compatibility matrix: Dev, can you share current iOS/Android owners? I can allocate docs time but need owners for technical sign-off.

Also, on the Nimbus exception: do we have the exact data categories and retention window they requested? If it's just a 30-day override for pilot data (no PHI), I think Security may be OK with compensating controls.

Marcus
Principal Product Manager

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch prioritization + doc gap triage: readiness checklist and exceptions

Adding a few concrete updates from Eng: 

- Feature/API freeze: engineering can commit to a contract freeze on May 17, but components tied to telemetry/metrics changes need an earlier cut (May 12). Suggest we treat schema changes as "hard freeze May 12" and non-breaking feature flags as May 17.
- SDK owners: Dev will take mobile SDKs (iOS/Android), I will own server SDKs and the integration examples.
- Critical items for week 0 (must have): support runbook + automated rollback, live metrics dashboards, canary gating thresholds. Everything else is week 1.

On Nimbus exception: Elena — can you paste the exact retention clause they requested? I flagged this as low-risk if it's scoped to pilot accounts and we add an audit trail.

I updated the rollout timeline spreadsheet with the week 0/week 1 tags and added owner columns. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/enablement-launch-2027 (sheet: rollout-timeline-202705.xlsx)

-Marissa
Staff Software Engineer, Runtime

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>, Matthew Cole <matthew.cole@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch prioritization + doc gap triage: readiness checklist and exceptions

Agree with Marissa's proposal on staggered freeze (schema May 12, other APIs May 17). That gives DX a runway to finish the SDK samples.

Regarding Nimbus: I reviewed their ask. They want a 45-day retention override for pilot telemetry tied to a closed test cohort. Security has proposed an audit-log condition and explicit consent flag. I will approve the exception for the pilot under these constraints if Security signs off. Elena, please share the final wording of the clause and the exact account IDs.

On rollout shape: propose a 2-stage canary (5% -> 20%) with automated rollback on error rate spike >1.5x baseline for 15 minutes. If that fails, fallback to previous model variant and open an incident. That keeps our SLA exposure minimal.

I updated the exceptions doc with the canary gating language and linked to INF-4321 for the automation work.

Laura Bennett
Senior Product Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Launch prioritization + doc gap triage: readiness checklist and exceptions

Thanks for the updates — this is looking good and actionable. Two quick items from leadership: 

1) Please make sure the final checklist explicitly calls out rollback owners (on-call + PM) and SLA impact thresholds. We don't want ambiguity during a canary.
2) For the Nimbus exception, get Security's written sign-off and a short-risk memo (one paragraph) that I can share with Ops & Legal before I give final approval.

Sofia — can you consolidate the doc owners and exception wording into a single one-page readiness memo by EOD Wednesday? If it's helpful, I can do a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow at 10:00 AM to resolve any open owners. Reply to accept the slot.

Hannah Schmitt
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
